themes.Foundation: Foundation data (org structure, locations, models, asset/CI sync)
themes.Hygiene: CI data quality (names, models, serials, staleness, duplicates, orphans)
themes.Customization: Class model and choice/relationship customizations (technical debt)
themes.Consumption: ITSM use of CIs and services

checks.title: Business Units without a Company
checks.action: Populate company on every business unit from the HR/finance source of truth; make company mandatory on the form/integration.

checks.title: CI-referenced Locations without a Parent Location
checks.issue_query: parentISEMPTY (restricted to locations referenced by non-retired CIs - use collector)
checks.action: Build a location hierarchy (Region > Country > State > City > Site > Building > Floor > Room) using Location Type; top-level nodes may legitimately have no parent.

checks.title: Duplicate Location names
checks.action: Identify a primary per duplicate group, repoint references, flag the rest as Duplicate (Rome+) and fix the feeding integration so it does not recreate them.

checks.title: Incidents without a Configuration Item
checks.action: Require CI before resolve; improve CI picker (reference qualifiers to operational classes, show identifying columns); train agents; use Service/Offering to narrow CI choice.

checks.title: Changes without a Configuration Item
checks.action: Require CI (or Affected CIs) before Assess/Authorize; use Dynamic CI Groups for bulk changes; drive risk and conflict detection from CI data.

checks.title: Changes missing a Service or a CI
checks.action: Populate Service/Service Offering alongside the CI (auto-derive from the CI's offering where possible) so change windows, risk and impact use service context.

checks.title: Incidents missing a Service or a CI
checks.action: Capture Service Offering and CI on every incident so SLAs, MTTR and outage reporting roll up to services.

checks.title: 'Create Asset on insert' business rule inactive or missing
checks.action: Re-activate the OOB rule (do not copy/modify it); verify model category asset/CI class mappings so assets are created for hardware and software CIs.

checks.title: Custom CMDB classes not following naming standard
checks.issue_query: custom extensions of cmdb_ci not named u_cmdb_ci_* (use collector)
checks.action: Review every custom class for an OOB/store-app equivalent (CMDB CI Class Models app); keep only justified ones, named u_cmdb_ci_*, created via CI Class Manager.

checks.title: Custom attributes defined at the wrong hierarchy level
checks.issue_query: same u_ element on several CMDB classes, or u_ element on cmdb_ci/cmdb (use collector)
checks.action: Consolidate duplicated attributes on the lowest common parent class; move root-level attributes down to the classes that use them.

checks.title: Custom attributes on CMDB classes
checks.action: Classify each as Best Practice / Keep / Refactor / Do Not Need; drop attributes populated on <10% of CIs or unused for years; map to OOB attributes where they exist.

checks.title: Custom attributes on ITAM tables
checks.action: Same rationalisation as CI-03 for asset and model tables; keep asset and CI attributes on the correct side of the asset-CI sync.

checks.title: Custom or relabelled CI status choice values
checks.action: Revert to OOB values and labels; express extra meaning with Life Cycle Stage/Status or a separate attribute; remap existing records before removing choices.

checks.title: Non-retired CIs with empty or invalid names
checks.action: Fix names at the source (discovery patterns, integrations); set a naming standard per class; add CMDB Health completeness rules for name.

checks.title: Hardware CIs with missing or wrong Model
checks.action: Enable hardware model normalisation; ensure discovery populates manufacturer+model; reassign CIs pointing at non-hardware or 'Unknown' models.

checks.title: Stale CIs (not updated in 90 days)
checks.action: Define staleness rules per class (CMDB Health); investigate discovery coverage; retire what no longer exists via CMDB Data Manager policies. Manually-managed design classes need attestation, not discovery.

checks.title: CIs with empty Discovery Source
checks.action: Every writer must identify itself: register sources in the discovery_source choice list, route writes through the IRE, back-fill legacy records with the real source.

checks.title: Duplicate CIs
checks.issue_query: duplicate_ofISNOTEMPTY (plus open reconcile_duplicate_task, plus shared serial numbers)
checks.action: Work de-duplication tasks with the Duplicate CI Remediator (merge, not delete); define de-duplication templates; fix identification rules and the non-IRE source that created them.

checks.title: Custom Service tables (not OOB CSDM service classes)
checks.action: Migrate records to cmdb_ci_service_business / cmdb_ci_service_technical / service_offering / cmdb_ci_service_auto children using the CSDM 5-step migration; retire the custom tables.

checks.title: Active Servers without a Location
checks.action: Derive location from IP ranges/subnets, data-centre or cloud region; set location from the asset where the asset is authoritative.

checks.title: Hardware CIs without Serial Number
checks.action: Fix discovery credentials/patterns that fail to read serials; include serial in identification rules; reject junk serials ('To be filled by O.E.M.', '0').

checks.title: Computer CIs where name and host name disagree
checks.action: Decide the naming rule (short vs FQDN), align reconciliation rules so one authoritative source owns name, and correct renamed hosts.

checks.title: Hardware and VM Instance CIs not updated in 90 days
checks.action: Check discovery schedules, MID servers and credentials; for cloud VMs verify cloud discovery; retire terminated instances automatically.

checks.title: 'Create CI on insert' (asset) business rule inactive or missing
checks.action: Re-activate the OOB rule so every tracked asset has its CI for workflows.

checks.title: CI-referenced Product Models without an owner
checks.issue_query: owner empty, restricted to models referenced by non-retired CIs (use collector)
checks.action: Assign product owners by model category/manufacturer; make ownership part of model intake; report EOL/EOS risk to owners.

checks.title: Technology Management Service Offerings missing Support or Change group
checks.action: Populate support, change and managed-by groups on every TSO so group synchronisation can push them to Dynamic CI Groups and CIs.

checks.title: Services and Offerings without an owner
checks.action: Name an accountable owner for every service and offering; add ownership to the service intake and periodic attestation.

checks.title: Custom Business Application tables
checks.issue_query: custom extensions of cmdb_ci_business_app, or custom 'app' tables outside cmdb_ci_appl (use collector)
checks.action: Move the application inventory into cmdb_ci_business_app (5-step migration); refactor dependencies; retire custom tables.

checks.title: Third-party data sources not using the IRE
checks.issue_query: active=true^target_tableSTARTSWITHcmdb_ci (review scripts for CMDBTransformUtil) + unregistered discovery_source values
checks.action: Replace direct transforms with Service Graph Connectors, IntegrationHub ETL/RTE or CMDBTransformUtil; register each source; configure identification, reconciliation and data refresh rules.

checks.title: No archive/retirement policy for CMDB data
checks.issue_query: no active archive rules on CMDB tables and no CMDB Data Manager policies
checks.action: Define CMDB Data Manager retire/archive/delete policies per class (or Data Archive rules on older releases), with retention aligned to audit needs.

checks.title: Modified or deleted base relationship types
checks.issue_query: OOB-created types updated by non-system users; deletions in sys_audit_delete (heuristic)
checks.action: Restore OOB types with their original sys_ids (from a PDI/update set), never delete base types; re-test service maps.

checks.title: Custom attributes on the CI relationship table
checks.action: Remove or relocate custom fields from cmdb_rel_ci (high-volume table); model extra meaning as CIs or on the related CIs.

checks.title: Custom relationship types
checks.issue_query: types not created by the system (heuristic; compare with PDI)
checks.action: Map custom types to base types (WWDD), re-point relationships, delete unused custom types; govern new types through the CMDB change process.

checks.title: Orphaned CI relationships
checks.action: Remove relationships whose parent or child no longer exists (batch, sub-prod first); find the process that deletes CIs without cascading.

checks.title: Information Objects without a Business Application
checks.issue_query: no cmdb_rel_ci from a Business Application (use collector)
checks.action: Relate each Information Object to the Business Applications that hold the data (Uses::Used by).

checks.title: Business Applications without an Information Object
checks.issue_query: no cmdb_rel_ci to an Information Object (use collector)
checks.action: Record the data types (PII, PCI, health...) each application holds, prioritising regulated and critical applications.

checks.title: Application Services without a Business Service Offering
checks.issue_query: no cmdb_rel_ci from a Business Service Offering (use collector)
checks.action: Relate Business Service Offering -> Application Service with Depends on::Used by so technical outages show business impact.

checks.title: Business Service Offerings without an Application Service
checks.issue_query: service_classification=Business Service with no child service instance (use collector)
checks.action: Model the service instances each business offering depends on (some offerings are purely people/process - document those exceptions).

checks.title: Business App -> Application Service relationships with a non-standard type
checks.issue_query: parent is Business App, child is Application Service, type != expected (use collector)
checks.population_query: all Business App -> Application Service relationships
checks.action: Standardise on the type your EA release expects (KB0831503: Consumes::Consumed by; CSDM 5 figure shows Uses::Used by) - confirm before bulk-changing.

checks.title: Application Services without a Business Application
checks.issue_query: no cmdb_rel_ci from a Business Application (use collector)
checks.action: Relate every Application Service to the Business Application it instantiates (one BA, many environments/regions).

checks.title: Business Applications without an Application Service
checks.issue_query: no cmdb_rel_ci to an Application Service (use collector)
checks.action: Create Application Services (wizard/API) for each deployed environment of in-production business applications; SaaS apps still get an Application Service.

checks.title: Technology Management Service Offerings without a parent Service
checks.action: Set the parent Technology Management Service on every TSO so cost, SLA and outage data roll up.

checks.title: Dynamic CI Groups without a CMDB Group
checks.action: Rebuild legacy (pre-Orlando) technical-service groupings as CMDB Groups (query builder/encoded query) and link them to the Dynamic CI Group.

checks.title: CIs related to more than one Technology Management Service Offering
checks.issue_query: child related to >1 technical service offering (direct relationships; use collector)
checks.action: Make each CI belong to exactly one TSO (directly or via one DCG) to avoid group-sync overwrites.

checks.title: Design-domain CIs used on incidents/changes
checks.action: Restrict CI reference qualifiers to operational classes; point users to Application Services/Service Offerings instead.

checks.title: Manually maintained Application (cmdb_ci_appl) CIs
checks.action: Move the application inventory to Business Application; let Discovery/Service Mapping own cmdb_ci_appl.

checks.title: Non-retired CIs without Life Cycle Stage
checks.action: Plan CSDM Life Cycle adoption (map legacy statuses; evaluate PI 2.0 in sub-prod). Informational until the customer commits to Life Cycle fields.

checks.title: Services on the generic cmdb_ci_service class
checks.action: Classify each record (business service, technology management service, or application service/service instance) and move it to the CSDM class with the 5-step migration; add offerings.

checks.title: CIs on the abstract base cmdb_ci class
checks.action: Reclassify to the correct class (or retire); block inserts into the base class.
